title: Budgeting Discretion accepted to NeurIPS 2026 as a spotlight
body: Our paper **[Budgeting Discretion: Theory and Evidence on Street-Level Decision-Making](project.html?id=modeling-discretion)** was accepted to **[NeurIPS 2026](https://neurips.cc/Conferences/2026)** and selected as a spotlight! See you in Atlanta in December.

title: Advanced to PhD candidacy
body: Defended my dissertation proposal at Virginia Tech and am now officially a PhD candidate.

title: Can LLMs Rank? accepted to AIES 2026
body: Our paper **[Can LLMs Rank? A Tale of Triads and Triage](project.html?id=can-llms-rank)** was accepted to **[AIES 2026](https://www.aies-conference.com/2026/)** in Malmö, Sweden.

title: New preprint: Can LLMs Rank?
body: We pair a circular-triad check with inter-run agreement to tell whether an LLM's rankings can be trusted — details on the [project page](project.html?id=can-llms-rank).

title: Presented at FAccT 2026
body: Presented **[Fixed Points and Stochastic Meritocracies: A Long-Term Perspective](project.html?id=stochastic-merit)** at **[FAccT 2026](https://facctconference.org/2026/index.html)** in Montreal.

title: Started research internship
body: Joined **[Pearson](https://www.pearson.com/en-us.html)** as an ML research intern on the Scoring Services team, working on evaluation methodology for model-assisted scoring workflows.

title: Accepted: Fixed Points and Stochastic Meritocracies
body: Our paper **[Fixed Points and Stochastic Meritocracies: A Long-Term Perspective](project.html?id=stochastic-merit)** was accepted to **[FAccT 2026](https://facctconference.org/2026/index.html)**.

title: Preprint: Budgeting Discretion
body: New preprint on modeling discretion as a budgeted resource available **[online](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10039)**.
